content:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing launch gates for the Optimize toolkit (batching / caching / quant recs + eval-triggered alerts). Need concrete acceptance metrics so we can sign-off with Sales for pilot customers. Who's got bandwidth to define thresholds?

sam: Happy to own econ thresholds. Proposing: 15% median token-cost reduction on pilot traffic OR $X/month savings, whichever is easier to communicate. Also need <5% tail latency regressions.

lee: For quant recs: success = model accuracy within 1 pt AUC (or equivalent) on our eval set + no >2% increase in hallucination rate. Can we standardize the eval harness to run across pilots?

jordan: Sales wants an observable metric they can show to customer: “estimated monthly savings” + sample inference traces. We should add a checkout checklist item: `sample_customer_dashboard` with before/after econ numbers.

ashley: Ops ask: rollout gate = canary for 48h with automatic rollback if error rate >0.5% or p99 latency > SLO by 20%. Also need clear runbook for manual rollback.

maria: Ok, draft acceptance criteria I'm hearing:
- Econ: >=15% median token cost reduction OR clear $ savings
- Latency: median latency no worse, p99 within 20% SLO
- Quality: model-level eval delta <=1 AUC pt / hallucination +2%
- Reliability: canary 48h, error rate <0.5% otherwise rollback
- Observability: dashboard + sample customer before/after

lee: Add: eval-triggered alerts must surface false-positive rate on top of precision/recall so customers don't get noisy alerts.

sam: Also recommend we include a minimum pilot size: >=100k tokens/day or 3 customers, whichever first, so econ signals are meaningful.

jordan: Pricing/legal: we need a pilot contract appendix that spells out what counts as “savings” and how we measure it. I'll loop in legal.

maria: Schedule: aiming for alpha gate review next Wed (3290015600). Action owners:
- sam: finalize econ calc and dashboard fields
- lee: publish eval harness + thresholds
- ashley: finalize canary automation + runbook
- jordan: pilot contract appendix draft

ashley: I'll add the runbook to ops-runbooks channel and link it here once done.

eval-bot: EVAL REPORT ready — baseline: devset AUC=0.874; quant-recommended AUC=0.869; hallucination delta=+0.9% — within proposed thresholds.

maria: Perfect. If teams can commit to the owners and timeline, I'll schedule the gate review invite. Tag me if anything slips. :thumbsup:

sam: On it, will post initial econ dashboard mock by EOD tomorrow.

lee: I'll open a PR with the harness and example results today.

jordan: Legal loop-in scheduled for tomorrow 10am.

maria: Thanks all — short and focused. We'll confirm next steps in the gate review thread.
